crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people…
But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.
translations.bsb: So Moses went out and relayed to the people the words of the LORD, and he gathered seventy of the elders of the people and had them stand around the tent.
translations.kjv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
translations.asv: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Jehovah: and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the Tent.
